rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Violetera
rows.Origin:
Bred by Simon (Simó) Dot (Spain, 1980).
Introduced in Italy by Rose Barni in 1980 as 'Violetera'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve, fuchsia / magenta flecks. Strong fragrance. 30 petals. Medium, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit: Tall. Medium, matte, dark green foliage.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
